This is a **local NCLEX-PN remediation planner**. You enter missed-topic tags and your own notes; it builds 5-, 7-, or 10-day study plans, tracks progress in JSON journals, and can show a local study-streak leaderboard. It produces study prompts, not clinical answers, and has no network or publishing setup. See the [README](README.md:1).

**Rules that apply:**

- Use topic tags and your own notes only. Do not paste or paraphrase paid question-bank questions, choices, rationales, or explanations into inputs or journals. The field validator cannot detect prohibited text inside an allowed note field. [Content rule](README.md:25)
- Check answers against current PN scope guidance for the learner’s jurisdiction and setting. The generated prompts use a PN scope lens, but user-written notes need human judgment. [Scope guidance](README.md:37)
- Keep personal input and progress files private. They are ignored by Git; group members should provide only study dates they choose to share for the leaderboard. [Sharing guidance](README.md:54)
